claim: The compact editor no longer overflows at a 320x480 or 320x440 viewport: the viewer placeholder keeps its icon and exposes its message through semantics on a short surface, and the timeline view controls are omitted when their strip is too short.

verification.detail: The editor job passed the analyzer, the focused component/semantics tests including the new 320x480 and 320x440 overflow regression, and the real Linux create/import/edit/undo/seek/save-reopen journey under a bounded Xvfb display.

limitations: This is a Linux debug app with a substituted file picker, not a packaged app or an OS-picker check.
The compact overflow regression is headless widget coverage; it does not establish rendering on a physical mobile device.
Exact-SHA Platform Verification and the macOS, Windows and Android gates are separate and are not established by this record.
The committed tree that was verified is c90f026; the only later change before merge was a dart-format-only commit.
